correctness.rationale: Every S_B is a valid depth-two numerical semigroup and each is uniquely recovered by its low elements. A residue-wise minimal generator proof gives e. Summand decompositions are disjoint matching constraints, yielding all coefficients and first moments. Infinite boundary law follows by coupling and a summable geometric tail; marginal CLT follows by binomial Slutsky. The independent reconstruction checker successfully verifies every B for 2<=r<=10; finite enumeration is not used to justify the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result solves a natural joint invariant gap left by genus-only enumeration: exact conditional means at every fixed genus, a surprising universal 5/2 embedding correction, and an exponentially convergent nondegenerate integer-valued e+g-2m limit rather than independent Gaussian behavior. It is an infinite two-parameter statement relevant to minimal generating sets, not a numeric table or arbitrary substitution.
